scripts.build: node scripts/quality/tracked-tree.mjs -- pnpm exec turbo build
scripts.ci:pr: node scripts/audit.mjs && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm quality:static && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build:ci && pnpm bundle:check && pnpm diff:check
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,convex,gateway --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter web dev" "pnpm exec convex dev" "pnpm --filter @zevium/gateway dev"
